content.text:
I didn't apply a label. The ticket is already categorized as a bug, which matches the report. The classifier returned "Credit reporting," a low-confidence result that doesn't fit this ticket, so I didn't use it.

Reply to the customer:

"Thank you for letting us know that your PDF notes stopped opening on iOS after the latest update, and that the app closes when you try. We've logged this as a high-priority bug, and we understand the timing matters with your exam on Friday. We'll follow up as soon as we have more information."
